title: TOKEN SOURCE
rule: one token source paints the hero specimen and the page around it; flip the specimen's theme and the page's cards follow while the band and the controls stay
description: A full-bleed cobalt band with one claim, 'Web and mobile products, from the token to the release.', and the live design-system specimen (invented kit) as the hero plate. Four notes pass under the pinned plate (805 tokens, 36 components, WCAG 2.1 AA floors, 20 releases); each one draws a hairline to the token row it names. Then three big cards in true order (Read to Feed 2022–25, Bayyinah TV 2023–26, the care platform 2026) and a record of ten results.
signature: Gentrit Display (Hubot Sans; its sister face draws the digits, because the display zero is barred) with JetBrains Mono for tokens and results, on white, with one cobalt. The page has no palette of its own for its cards: it reads the specimen's computed CSS variables (card.surface, text.primary, action.primary, action.soft, border.focus) and paints with them; the band is core cobalt.600, so it does not flip. The notes read the specimen's own lane text, so 'button.solid.bg → action.primary → cobalt.600' becomes 'cobalt.400' in dark, and each card names the token its surface reads ('card.surface → stone.0 / stone.900'). Motion: S2, the plate pins while the four notes pass; when a note crosses the pin line its hairline draws in 180 ms (the run outside the plate, then the run inside it, white over the band and cobalt below it), a 120 ms ring marks the token row, the previous hairline fades in 120 ms; the line stays tethered while the note scrolls. Theme flip: the specimen's own circular reveal changes the source first; the page's surfaces follow 200 ms later with a 200 ms colour tween (no text cross-fade, no remount, the care chart keeps its state and turns dark through light-dark()). S1: three cards oldest first, so the newer card covers the older one, which scales to 0.96 on a view timeline. Phone: the plate pins at 343 px wide, ends after the first token lane, and scrolls its own content to the row the current note names. Keyboard: 'Work' jumps to the cards with no travel. Reduced motion: hairlines appear with no draw, the flip switches state, no stack scale.
holdback: Lowest: original, 7/10. The hero is a claim on a coloured band with a product plate that overlaps the band's lower edge, which is a known launch-page pattern, and the sticky card stack is a familiar scroll pattern even in true order. What is new is that the page is themed by its own hero: the notes and cards read the specimen's live tokens, the flip changes the source first and the page follows, and the token names on the page change with it. Not overwhelming is 7.5 because the specimen itself is dense (five token lanes and five alerts) on the first screen. Hooks is 7.5 because the flip is one click away but a visitor must try it; the caption at the control ('Light or Dark: this page follows ↓') is the only prompt. Known deviations from the plan: the plate is 1200 × 426, not 1200 × 600, because the specimen's second board row is cut at 600 px and a plate must end on a whole row; the notes pass under the plate, not beside it, so the plate keeps its full 1200 px width; the flip follows with a 200 ms delay so the source visibly changes first. Slop 0.5: the hero is the claim-on-band plus overlapping product shot layout.
